name: neve-source-retrieval
description: Plain-language and paraphrased questions with the sections of the synthetic pack that should be among the top 3 retrieved (what Legal Copilot passes to the model). Labels are section numbers; recall is the headline score (recall@3), precision is low by design. The pack is copied from neve-legal-retrieval; it is invented for testing, is not real law and must never be loaded as an approved source.

sections.heading: Advance rent and security deposit
sections.text: A landlord may take an advance or security deposit from the tenant only up to the amount agreed in writing, and must give a receipt for it.

sections.heading: Return of the deposit
sections.text: When the tenancy ends, the landlord returns the deposit within a reasonable time, less any amount for unpaid rent or damage shown with evidence.

sections.heading: Rent receipts
sections.text: The landlord gives a signed receipt for every rent payment, stating the amount and the month it covers.

sections.heading: Rent increases
sections.text: Rent may be increased only as the written agreement allows, and the tenant must be told in writing before the increase takes effect.

sections.heading: Notice to end the tenancy
sections.text: Either party ending a monthly tenancy gives written notice before the end of a rental month, as the agreement sets out.

sections.heading: Eviction
sections.text: A tenant may be required to leave only for the reasons and through the steps the law allows, after notice in writing.

sections.heading: Repairs and maintenance
sections.text: The landlord keeps the premises in a fit state of repair; the tenant takes reasonable care and reports damage promptly.

sections.heading: Utilities and service charges
sections.text: Electricity, gas, water and service charges are paid by the party the agreement names; charges passed on must be shown with bills.

cases.question: Is there a limit on how much security money the owner can ask for up front?
